summary: Unit tests in test/units cover mostly internals but also modules, organized by module group under test/units/modules. They may include some functional testing for cases integration tests can't verify.
questions: Where are the unit tests for Ansible modules?
Why do some module unit tests do functional testing?

answer_card.title: Module unit tests in ansible-core
answer_card.answer_md: Unit tests live in `test/units`, mirroring the code layout; module tests are under `test/units/modules/`, grouped by module group. Because some cases can't be checked by integration tests, module unit tests sometimes go beyond tiny units and include some functional testing.
